description: Source file defining the RejectedPromise class, which implements PromiseInterface for handling rejected promises in the GuzzleHttp Promise library.

classes.name: RejectedPromise
classes.description: A class representing a promise that has been explicitly rejected, implementing PromiseInterface to interact with promise-based asynchronous operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a RejectedPromise with a given reason, ensuring it is not itself a promise.

methods.name: then
methods.description: Registers callbacks to handle fulfillment or rejection; only the rejection callback is relevant for RejectedPromise.

methods.name: otherwise
methods.description: Provides a convenience method to handle rejection.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Blocks execution until the promise settles, optionally unwrapping and throwing an exception if rejected.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the promise, which is 'REJECTED'.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Attempts to resolve the promise, but throws an exception because the promise is rejected.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects the promise with a given reason; only allows rejection if the reason matches the original.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Method stub for cancelling the promise; does nothing in this implementation.
